name: AMETEK, Inc.
price_source: StockAnalysis.com (Jun-22-2026 close); cross-checked Yahoo Finance $237.42 Jun-18-2026 — used most recent/highest
owner_fcf_base: Owner FCF = FY2025 FCF $1,671.6M − 100% SBC $47.8M = $1,623.8M total = $7.06/sh (229.835M diluted). SBC only 2.9% of FCF so owner earnings ~ reported FCF.

conservador.note: Phase1 6% CAGR (organic ~5% + bolt-on M&A slows), decline to 3% terminal, WACC 10%, g 3%. Reasonable-pessimistic: macro/industrial softness, fewer accretive deals — not apocalyptic.

base.note: Phase1 8.5% CAGR (mid-single organic + steady accretive acquisitions, AME's proven playbook), decline to 3% terminal, WACC 10%, g 3%.

optimista.note: Phase1 11% CAGR (strong organic + large accretive M&A pipeline, margin expansion), decline to 3% terminal.

multiple_rationale: Fair multiple 27.5x = modest haircut to 5y avg 29.4x and below current 28.6x. Haircut reflects higher-rate regime (not structural deterioration). AME is a proven serial-acquirer compounder of niche, high-margin instrument businesses; GAAP ROIC 11.2% is depressed by acquisition goodwill — underlying/cash returns far higher. Orders +23%, record backlog $3.87B, guidance raised: no cyclical/structural impairment. Applied to FY2026 guided adj EPS midpoint $8.04.
structural_change: Ninguno. Sin deterioro estructural: resultados record FY2025 y Q1 2026, ordenes +23%, backlog record $3.87B, margen operativo 26.7%, guia FY2026 elevada a $7.94-$8.14 adj EPS. Apalancamiento bajo (ND/EBITDA 0.74x), SBC muy bajo (2.9% del FCF). Modelo de roll-up de instrumentacion diferenciada intacto.
sanity_notes: Precio $241.55 verificado (StockAnalysis Jun-22; Yahoo $237.42 Jun-18). Acciones diluidas 229.835M (10-Q Q1 2026 weighted avg) — coincide con 229.2M de agregadores. Implied mcap = 241.55 × 0.229835 = $55.52B, coincide con escala conocida (~$55B). mcap_sanity_ok. Todos los IV en rango de magnitud razonable (51-92% del precio), sin error de unidades/moneda/acciones. DIVERGENCIA DCF vs multiplo: DCF puro ($137) infra-credita el reinvertir de un compounder a ROIC alto durante decadas y trata el multiplo de salida via terminal g; el mercado y la media 5a (~29x) reflejan esa capacidad de composicion — por eso se pondera mas el multiplo (0.60). reconciled_IV $187.55 implica que la accion cotiza ~29% POR ENCIMA del valor intrinseco reconciliado a $241.55: calidad alta pero NO barata, cotiza a/cerca de maximos (-0.7% del max 52s). Sin margen de seguridad al precio actual.
